Short title and commencement

ACT XI OF 2010
ACT XI OF 2010
BALOCHISTAN LAND LAWS (AMENDMENT)
ACT, 2010
An Act further to amend certain land laws
[Gazette of Balochistan, Extraordinary,
7th July, 2010]
No.PAB/Legis:V(12)/2010,
dated 7-7-2010.--The Balochistan Land Laws (Amendment) Bill 2010 having been
passed by the Provincial Assembly of Balochsitan on 1st July, 2010, and
assented to by the
Governor,
Balochistan, on 5th July, 2010, is hereby published as an Act of the Provincial
Assembly.
Preamble.---Whereas it is expedient further to amend certain
laws in the manner herein after appearing;
It is hereby
enacted as follows:-
1. Short title
and commencement.---(l) This Act
may be called the Balochistan Land Laws (Amendment) Act, 2010.
(2) It shall come
into force at once.
